title: ABC 5 - klub
description: Klub fantastyki — przy stole. Halinka i Czesław prezentują odbudowany dom kultury. A: render Blender; B: dodanie postaci i korekta skali; C: fotograficzne materiały i światło. Statyczne ujęcie 4 s. Źródła i pełna sekwencja promptów w generation-history.

prompts.image: Correct only two unwanted additions in image 1 using image 2 (B) as geometry reference: remove the newly invented dark skirting/baseboard strip along the right/back walls, restoring the original simple wall-floor junction; remove any newly invented floor tile/grid lines, keeping a seamless warm-gray matte floor. Preserve all people, identities, scale, poses, camera, furniture, paper, dice, signs, photographic lighting and texture elsewhere. Do not add any new objects, seams or decor. Image 1 is the photo edit target; image 2 supplies original wall/floor geometry only.
